summary: @servicetitan/assist-utils@1.1.7 executes obfuscated payload via dropped Bun runtime on npm install
details: Version 1.1.7 adds a `preinstall` hook (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime from oven-sh's GitHub release at bun-v1.3.13, extracts it, chmods it executable, and then invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js` — a ~727KB single-line `// @bun @bun-cjs` bundle containing a rotated string-array VM, mangled identifiers, and platform/filesystem/network primitives. `math_init.js` is not referenced from the declared React/mobx `main` (`./dist/index.js`), is not mentioned in README or CHANGELOG (which stops at 1.1.1 and describes only UI refactors), and is reachable only through the dropped alternate runtime. `setup.mjs` itself uses obfuscator.io-style identifiers (`_0x488df8`, `_0x52943e`) and control-flow lookup tables, inconsistent with the rest of the package's authored source. The alternate-runtime-dropper shape (second interpreter fetched specifically to execute an opaque bundle Node-based tooling cannot inspect) fires automatically on `npm install`, turning installation into execution of attacker-controlled code. Package purpose (React/mobx MFE utilities) does not require a second language runtime or a 727KB opaque payload, and the additions are undocumented across the 1.1.2–1.1.7 range — consistent with a compromised-publisher republish.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
